FROM: C. B. FUCH

SUBJECT: KOOL LIGHTS DELISTING MEASUREMENT - UPDATE

BACKGROUND

KOOL Lights (KB and 100's) were delisted in Arkansas (TA 45) in November, 1984. This action was taken in order to test a potential approach of enabling B&W to bring new products into the brand portfolio without the heavy cost of buying additional retail space. This memo also addresses the effect of KOOL Ultra delisting on KDOL family.

TEST HYPOTHESIS

There will be no negative sales impact on the KOOL family upon KOOL Lights" (KS and 100's) delisting.

MANAGEMENT DECISION

If no negative sales impact is determined, this approach will offer management a viable method of attaining distribution for new products without hurting existing B&W brands.

CONCLUSION

The test hypothesis is accepted.

RESULTS

Over the past six months (July 1985 - December 1985), the KOOL family's market share (both nationally and in TA 45) has slowed its decline. There appears to be no negative impact on other members of the KOOL family due to delisting KOOL Lights, or the subsequent delisting of KOOL Ultra.
